messages:
zara: Kickoff: Hackweek Starter Refapp playbook. Goal: drive contributor conversions and collect qualified demo leads. Targets: 500 forks, 80 webinar regs, 20 SDR-qualified leads :rocket:
zara: Proposal: split content into 3 tracks — Quickstart (15m), Benchmarks (20m), Extend (30m). Keeps live session focused and gives clear prework for attendees.
rick: Love the tracks. For benchmarks we need a reproducible script + sample CSV output so community results are comparable. I'll sketch that helper.
leah: Suggest a public leaderboard in the README showing top contributors & PRs merged during Hackweek :trophy: could boost engagement.
amanda: Marketing scope: blog post, landing page, 4 social cards, 2 short demo videos, email seq (3 touches). I can own assets and cadence.
jason: For perf helper, something tiny: `python measure.py --model rdx-mini-q4 --reps 20 --prompt "hello"` returns mean/p95/p99 and token counts. Will add to README.
li: I'll draft 3 benchmark bullets: chat latency (q4 local vs hosted), embeddings throughput (items/sec) and cost per 1k tokens. Short, quantifiable, and workload notes.
maya: Webinar plan: 40m dev workshop + 20m open office hours. Proposed Tue May 9 10am PT. @sam can you run infra demo and failover? :calendar:
sam: Yep. I'll do a stress test and show graceful fallback to a smaller quantized variant and a quick Dedicated->Private routing example.
amanda: Lead form: include checkbox "Interested in a concierge sandbox demo" and a free-text "use-case brief". Add utm_source=hackweek2026 to links.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: hackweek-starter-refapp (owner: zara), landing draft: https://redwood.example/hackweek-starter (assets: placeholder)
zara: Prize plan: swag + 1-month Dedicated trial for top 3 contributors. Need finance sign-off (cc @sara-finance in the doc).
leah: Repo ops: add issues template "I ran benchmarks" and a CONTRIBUTING.md with tiny steps. Also include a prework checklist on the landing page to reduce live support load.
rick: Action items roundup: zara -> blog & landing copy (Thu), amanda -> assets + email cadence (Fri), jason -> perf helper + sample CSV (Thu), li -> benchmark bullets + chart (Fri), sam -> infra dry run + stress scripts (Mon). Dry run scheduled Fri May 6 11am PT for 30m.
zara: Moving tasks to the board. Please update status in this thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
